TAL_ATHLETICS_RAPID_MOTION.why: "Dash as a Bonus Action" (Rapid Motion, Technique): a granted bonus-action move up to your Speed, the same shape as Step Through Darkness's own granted-action bonus-action teleport in combat/rules/feature_blocks.json.

TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_PATIENT_WATER.why: Taking the Dodge action marks you; a hostile creature's attack roll against you removes the mark; at the start of your next turn a mark still there regains Martial Focus if it is absent (combat/ext/flowing_river.py; rider lane C10 replaced the immediate regain).
